title: SPECTRE: Conditional System Prompt Poisoning to Hijack LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success rate of a conditional prompt poisoning attack (SPECTRE) in forcing models to output targeted, compromised responses to political queries sampled from the TruthfulQA dataset.

Measuring the effectiveness of the prompt poisoning attack in manipulating model responses to stereotype-related questions sampled from the TruthfulQA dataset, evaluated using exact match (EM) and F1 scores in multiple-choice and free-form formats.
